verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents purpose-specific cards (travel, software, ads) with a set limit for each goal, assigned to responsible people. Custom VCNs have adjustable ceilings, time windows and controls, and the platform has an 'Área de aprovações' (approvals area). Together these give a card-limit form of spend policy and some human approval step. Nothing shows a rules engine that auto-approves in-policy expenses and routes only exceptions to a reviewer. missing for 10: codified policy rules by category/role/context, automatic approval of in-policy expenses, exception-only routing to approvers, documentation of how the approvals area works, independent corroboration
